name: pixelagents
short: Pixel Agents webview bundle and office-state schema boundary
description: Builds the pinned Pixel Agents webview and provides the validated, lazy-initialized office-state facade used by cctv, floorplan, architect, and painter. Corridor owns the opaque persisted aggregates; this cog owns their Pixel Agents schema interpretation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, in corridor's office-state store, each Discord account's office character (a pixatar seed code and the character profile it stands for, keyed by user ID) and that account's seat in each server's office and the editor office, plus a rendered avatar PNG of each character in its data folder. A data deletion request deletes all of it.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Heavy IO and outside services: on load it clones the pinned Pixel Agents webview (GitHub) and the pixatar CLI (github.com/pixel-agents-hq/index), runs npm ci and a Vite build, and keeps the checkouts, node_modules, build output and an avatar image cache in its data folder. Setup: the host needs git and Node.js 22+ with npm ([p]toolbox node install can provide Node). Bot owner: [p]pixelagents webview commit/rebuild and [p]pixelagents pixatar. cctv serves the built webview.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
